name: Maples造型师
tagline: Builds MapleStory outfits you can actually reproduce in game
description: Describe the look you are after, or hand it a picture, and three complete builds come back for maples.im. Each is written out as a recipe, the exact items involved, so it can be assembled piece by piece; each is shown moving in an official preview clip, and the whole walking sprite set arrives as a zip.
author: cgnot996
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
